notes: Thirty born-digital papers, five per field. PDFs are not committed. scripts/corpus-fetch.mjs downloads them and checks contentFingerprint.

contentFingerprint is a SHA-256 over pdf.js page text (string and text matrix, rounded to 0.01), page count, media-box size, and rotation. The Info dictionary, XMP, and trailer /ID are excluded. A Cambridge page line matching ^Downloaded from … IP address is stripped before hashing, so a new download time does not change it. sha256 is one observed byte hash and is not used for verification.
No Word-exported PDFs. Papers whose display equations were raster images were rejected.

Economics/finance is the sixth field. Each field has at least three publisher-typeset PDFs. Attention (1706.03762) and DDPM (2006.11239) stay arXiv. Economics also keeps one q-fin preprint (1410.3394) because the next anonymous CC BY finance PDFs were not formula-dense.
Physical Review X, Wiley, IOP, PNAS, and Royal Society direct PDFs returned HTTP 403. Those hosts were skipped. No spoofed headers.
sourceType is publisher-typeset (Springer production, Arbortext, InDesign, PDFlib), author-latex-journal, or author-latex-preprint.
tests/fixtures/DDPM_2006.11239.pdf, if present and matching the content fingerprint, is an accepted local copy of 2006.11239.
